# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest commit on `main` is supported. It is the version running in production at https://ddslack.tbelt.online.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through GitHub: [open a security advisory](https://github.com/tBeltty/ddslack/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue, and do not include real tokens or secrets in the report.

Please include what an attacker could do, the steps to reproduce it, and the affected files or endpoints if you know them.

## What to expect

- An acknowledgement within 7 days.
- An assessment and a plan within 30 days.
- Credit in the advisory once a fix is deployed, unless you prefer to stay anonymous.
